name: Harry S. Truman Farm Home
address: 12302 Blue Ridge Boulevard, Grandview, Jackson County, MO

location.how: centre of the building's outline clicked by hand on the public ortho mo-2023-2024 (2024, 0.150 m/px), pixel (636, 505)

standing.note: The farmhouse south of Blue Ridge Boulevard in the NPS grounds beside the visitor parking (located from the historical marker coordinates, 38 deg 54.1 min N, 94 deg 31.85 min W); about 108 x 76 px (16 x 11 m) with porches and eaves against walls of 44 ft 5 in x 36 ft 4 in plus a 5 ft 10 in porch; the two-storey hip block and the lower wings read as drawn; no addition visible. NPS-owned.

plan.north: up (the arrow points to the sheet's top; the front porch faces west, sheet left)
plan.note: Start at the parlor's top-left (north-west) outside corner and walk clockwise on the sheet: two-storey west block (parlor, hall, sitting room, 16'-3" x 36'-4"), two-storey dining block east of it, one-storey kitchen wing east of that. The plan has no bottom string, so the three south walls are taken from the north walls they mirror (checked on the sheet).

chain.label: west block's east wall above the dining block

length.note: left overall 36'-2" less 8'-9 1/2" and 18'-6" = 8'-10 1/2"; the right string prints 8'-5" here, which scales 9.07 ft and does not close to 36'-2"

chain.label: west block's east wall below the dining block

length.note: taken equal to the top 16'-1": the bottom string's first segment over this wall prints only 0" (digits missing); with 2'-5" + 6'-9" it scales 7.0 + 2.4 + 6.8 ft

floors.note: Over the west block and the dining block (four bedrooms and hall); the kitchen wing is one storey. The second floor's strings read 1-3" smaller than the first floor's for the same walls (16'-1" vs 16'-3", 36'-2" vs 36'-4", 15'-11" vs 16'-2"); the walls are at the same sheet positions within 0.1 ft.

eave.note: printed as a dimension from grade to the eave (top of the box gutter/cornice) on the left (south end) string; the right (north end) string reads 19'-11". No level datum is printed on any elevation; 0'-0" stands for the grade the dimension starts at.

ridge.note: west elevation left string: 19'-9 1/2" (grade to eave) + 7'-8" (eave to the hip roof's ridge) = 27'-5 1/2"; the right string gives 19'-11" + 7'-9" = 27'-8"

readings.note: scales 9.52 ft (1428 px at 150 px/ft); every other elevation puts the eave 19'-8" to 20'-6" above grade, so 10'-6" is probably a misprint for 9'-6"

readings.what: second floor to window head level

overhang.note: mean of the two passes' scaled readings, 1.25 and 1.1 ft

roof.note: West block: hip roof, eaves all round its exposed sides. Dining block and kitchen wing: east-west gables with eaves on the north and south and rakes on the east. No roof plan; the eave level differs by block (main 19'-8" to 20'-6" above grade, dining block's eave about 13.5 ft scaled, kitchen 7'-10").
roof.derive_note: hip over the west block with lower gables over the dining block and the kitchen wing: mixed

a.note: top string, porch edge to the west wall

b.note: sheet 2: porch floor from about y 2960 to 6960 px at 150 px/ft

flags.note: No printed east-west overall of the walls: the top string's 50'-3 1/2" includes the 5'-10 1/2" west porch (walls 44'-5"), and the plan has no bottom string. North-south both side strings add to 36'-4" and the chain matches.

Three south walls (kitchen, dining block, sitting room) are derived from the north walls they mirror because the first floor plan has no bottom string; checked on the sheet (corners line up within 0.1 ft).

The first and second floor plans print the same walls 1-3" apart (16'-3" / 16'-1", 36'-4" / 36'-2", 16'-2" / 15'-11"); the parlor's 16'-3" scales 16.12 ft, and its first 6'-11" segment scales 6.81 ft, so the first floor's 16'-3" may be about 2" long.

North elevation: second floor to eave prints 10'-6" but scales 9.52 ft; read as a likely misprint for 9'-6". Second floor plan: the right string's lowest segment prints 8'-5" but scales 9.07 ft and the left overall needs 8'-10 1/2"; the bottom string's first west-block segment prints only 0".

Grade varies: the eave over the main block is 19'-9 1/2" (west elevation, south end), 19'-11" (west, north end), 19'-10" (south), 20'-1" and 20'-6" (east). One eave height also ignores the lower dining-block and kitchen eaves.
